MAR — Marine Excursion

Chumbe Island coral park day

Full day · Mbweni → Chumbe Island

From $115–$135 per person
Book via WhatsApp

Overview

Visit the world's first private marine conservation park. Chumbe Island limits visitors to just 14 per day to protect its fragile coral ecosystem. Snorkel guided by a marine biologist, learn about coral restoration, and support conservation.

What to Expect

  • Full-day trip from Mbweni (south of Stone Town)
  • Small-group snorkeling (max 14 guests per day)
  • Marine biologist guide explains coral reef ecology
  • Snorkel over pristine, protected coral walls
  • Organic lunch and refreshments included
  • Day room access for changing and relaxing

Duration & Meeting Point

Duration: Full day (8–9 hours)

Meeting point: Mbweni Beach (pickup from central hotels by arrangement)

Important Notes

  • Advance booking essential — strictly limited to 14 visitors per day
  • All profits support the Chumbe Conservation Fund
  • Bring your own snorkel mask if you have one
  • No single supplement for solo travelers

Inclusions

  • Boat, marine-biology guide, snorkeling, lunch, day room

📍 Tour Details

  • Location:Mbweni → Chumbe Island
